title: [replay r2] feat(kaipu): NIW2-218 export presets pipeline and fast start
body:
> **Replay of [niway-dev/kaipu-record#269](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/269), run 2** for the code-review benchmark. Same base and head commits as the round-1 replay (a second branch name on the same commit, so the reviewer sees a fresh pull request). Never merged. Method: [wachiman/docs/benchmark](https://github.com/niway-dev/wachiman/tree/main/docs/benchmark).

---

Refs NIW2-218

Stacked on #266 (`feat/NIW2-217-gif-export`). PR 1 of 3 (spec "Size" split): pipeline + fast start. Next: #271 (presets UI), #272 (Small-file size check).

## Summary
- `export/export-presets.ts` (new, pure, worker-safe): one table for Original, YouTube 16:9 (1920×1080), Vertical 9:16 (1080×1920), Square 1:1 (1080×1080), Small file 10/25 MB. `resolveExportTarget()` returns size, framing, bitrates, fps cap, mono downmix, fast start, `maximumPacketCount`s, size estimate and "achievable" for the cap. Platform sources in comments.
- `compose-frame.ts`: pure `framingRect()` (Fit/Fill). `compose-output-frame.ts`: `createFramer()` draws the composed view onto the target canvas, with black or blurred-frame padding.
- `export-worker.ts`: fixed-canvas presets compose a **source-size view** (frame → redactions → overlays → zoom crop, unchanged) and then frame it; Original and Small file compose straight onto the output. Explicit bitrates (Original keeps `QUALITY_HIGH`), fps cap (drop frames before the next 1/maxFps slot), mono downmix, `canEncodeVideo` check with software fallback, and **`fastStart: 'reserve'` on every export** (never `'in-memory'`).
- `use-video-export.ts`: `start()` accepts `presetId`/`framing`/`sourceInfo` (defaults to Original, so the editor behaves as before plus fast start). A "maximum packet count" error aborts that writer session and retries once with `fastStart: false` (logged via `captureException`). The message now carries `source` and `target`.
- Backlog doc `backlog/export-presets.md` (🟡) + index/sidebar rows.

**Spec:** `/Users/csdev/.hermes/workspace/specs/kaipu/NIW2-218.md` (Linear NIW2-218), spec draft approved by Cristian 2026-10-09 with defaults.

## Assumed defaults
- Q1 fast start on every preset, no toggle. Q2 padding: blurred copy of the frame for Vertical/Square Fit, black for YouTube. Q3 Vertical = Fill, Square = Fit. Q7 fixed presets upscale to the exact canvas; only Small file never upscales. Q11 keep source fps on fixed presets (12 Mbps > 30 fps); cap 30 fps only on Small-file rungs below 1080p.
- Implementation choices: the Small-file bitrate is capped at the fixed-preset rate for its size (a 5 s clip doesn't get 30 Mbps); the moov reservation (~35 B/packet, ≈430 KB on a 2-min export) is subtracted from the Small-file budget; video packet counts never assume < 30 fps without a cap (screen recordings are VFR), and the worker raises them using the source's real packet rate.

## How to try it
This slice has no UI change: Export → Video (MP4) still exports the Original preset.
1. `cd apps/kaipu-record && bun run dev`, open a recording in the editor, add a cut, a zoom, a blur and an arrow.
2. Export → Video (MP4). Confirm the result looks exactly as before (cuts, zoom, blur, overlay, poster).
3. Check fast start: `ffprobe -v trace <file> 2>&1 | grep -m2 -E "type:'(moov|mdat)'"` shows `moov` before `mdat`, or drag the file into Safari: it should play and seek immediately.
4. Presets are exercised from the UI in the next PR of the stack.

## Verified
- `bun run check-types` ✅ · `bun run test` ✅ (kaipu-record 199 files / 1465 tests) · `bun run lint` ✅ (0 errors; 15 pre-existing warnings).
- New tests: `export-presets.test.ts` (dimensions per preset × 16:9 / 1662×1080 / 4:3 / 32:9 / portrait / 720p sources, even rounding, no upscale on Small file, ladder at 30 s / 2 / 5 / 15 min × 10 / 25 MB, audio / no-audio budgets, packet counts), `framingRect` cases in `compose-frame.test.ts`, hook tests for target pass-through and the fast-start fallback.

## Not verified
- Real exports in the app (WebCodecs + OffscreenCanvas in the worker can't run in jsdom): output dimensions via ffprobe, moov-before-mdat, `elst` absence, playback in Safari/Chrome/QuickTime, hardware encode of 1080×1920, export-time cost of the composite path.
- E2E preset fixture checks (spec's desktop e2e tier): not written in this run.

## Where to look first
- `export-worker.ts` → `runExportWithInput`: the `framed`/`composeSize`/`framer` split, the fps-cap `nextSlot`, and the `maximumPacketCount` block.
- `export-presets.ts` → `resolveSmallFile`.
- `use-video-export.ts` → the `launch()` refactor and the `PACKET_RESERVE_ERROR` retry.

## Proposed spec changes
None.
